_om: Kunstneren in English (Doodler, rusj.no/en/doodler/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. «Hviskeleken» (draw, guess, draw … round the table) is «Pass the Picture». The words are in data.en/ord.json, written for the UK. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
Nå er det fullt i skisseboka – denne teg: The sketchbook is full – this drawing is finished!
Tegneark – tegn med fingeren eller musa: Drawing sheet – draw with your finger or the mouse
Snu mobilen før du titter: Turn the phone away before you peek
Ordet vises ved siden av knappen. Trykk: The word is shown next to the button. Tap again to hide it.
Lagene fordeles annenhver etter lista. L: The teams are dealt out in turn down the list. The drawer's team guesses.
Én tegner, resten gjetter i kor: One draws, everyone else shouts out guesses
Tegning blir gjetning blir tegning …: A drawing becomes a guess becomes a drawing …
Mobilen går rundt i denne rekkefølgen. D: The phone goes round in this order. The whole table guesses the last drawing together.
The phone goes round in this order.
Dere to spiller sammen: hvor mange tegni: You two play together: how many drawings can you get?
Alle tegner etter tur, i denne rekkefølg: Everyone draws in turn, in this order.
Noen tegninger får en vri: feil hånd, lu: Some drawings get a twist: wrong hand, eyes shut, straight lines only …
Klokka starter når tegneren setter først: The clock starts when the drawer makes the first line. Short times make the funniest chains.
Én runde: alle tegner eller gjetter én g: One round: everyone draws or guesses once.
Velg minst én kategori under «Flere valg: Choose at least one category under ‘More options’
The others shout out their guesses.
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se: Hold your finger on the card to see
Hold fingeren på kortet for å se det hem: Hold your finger on the card to see the secret word
Ropte noen riktig i siste liten?: Did someone shout it out just in time?
Vis ordet – hold fingeren her: Show the word – hold your finger here
Some words are just plain tricky.
Gjettet på {tid}! +1 til {navn} for tegn: Guessed in {tid}! +1 to {navn} for the drawing.
Full pott – alle tegningene ble gjettet!: Full marks – every drawing was guessed!
Now you have a record to beat next time.
Exactly as good as your record.
Del utstillingen som bilde: Share the exhibition as a picture
Hele bordet gjetter den siste tegningen: The whole table guesses the last drawing together
Put the phone where everyone can see.
Du skal gjette hva tegningen er: You're guessing what the drawing is
Ikke vis skjermen til de andre: Don't show the screen to the others
Klokka starter når du tegner: The clock starts when you draw
Hva tror dere dette er?: What do you think this is?
{navn} knows the answer and keeps quiet.
Hva tror dere tegningen er?: What do you all think the drawing is?
Hva tror du tegningen er?: What do you think the drawing is?
Nå får dere se hva ordet ble til på veie: Now you'll see what the word turned into on its way round the table.
Ingen gjetninger traff blink. Herlig kao: Not one guess was spot on. Glorious chaos!
Alle gjetningene traff blink. Er dere ta: Every guess was spot on. Are you mind readers?
Del kjeden som bilde: Share the chain as a picture
Ett spill, to måter: tegn og gjett i kor: One game, two ways: draw and guess all together – or send the drawings round the table in Pass the Picture.
Tegneren holder fingeren på kortet og se: The drawer holds a finger on the card to see the secret word. The others look away.
Tegn før tiden renner ut. Ingen bokstave: Draw before time runs out. No letters, numbers or sounds – just lines!
Trykk «Gjettet!» og så på den som gjette: Tap ‘Got it!’ and then the person who guessed first. The guesser gets 1 point – and so does the drawer.
Start med store, enkle former. Detaljer: Start with big, simple shapes. Details can come later.
«Angre» tar bort én strek om gangen – og: ‘Undo’ takes away one line at a time – and even ‘Clear’ can be undone.
Glemt ordet midt i tegningen? Snu mobile: Forgotten the word mid-drawing? Turn the phone away and hold your finger on the eye at the top.
Er dere to? Da spiller dere sammen: hvor: Just the two of you? Then you play together: how many drawings can you get – and can you beat your record?
Slå på «Kunstnerkrav» for tegninger med: Turn on ‘Artist's challenge’ for drawings with a twist: wrong hand, eyes shut and more.
Den første får et hemmelig ord og tegner: The first player gets a secret word and draws it.
Neste ser bare tegningen og skriver hva: The next only sees the drawing and writes what it shows.
Neste ser bare svaret og tegner det – og: The next only sees the answer and draws it – and so the phone goes round.
Hviskeleken er for fire eller flere, og: Pass the Picture is for four or more, and everyone takes part once. With an odd number, the whole table guesses the last drawing together. At the end the whole chain is played back, line by line. How far from the starting word did you end up?
Hviskeleken trenger fire spillere – nå b: Pass the Picture needs four players – switching to Draw and guess
Skriv hva du tror tegningen er: Type what you think the drawing is
Dere går rett til kåringen, og resten av: You'll go straight to the results, and the rest of the drawings are skipped.
You'll see the chain as far as it got.
You can always start a new one.
Nytt ord! Hold fingeren på kortet for å: New word! Hold your finger on the card to see it.
Angret – poengene er tatt tilbake: Undone – the points have been taken back
Helt greit! Ingen får poeng, og ordet bl: No problem! Nobody scores, and the word is shown.
Hele kjeden med tegninger og gjetninger: The whole chain with drawings and guesses
Alle tegningene fra spillet: All the drawings from the game
Bildet lages her på mobilen og sendes in: The picture is made here on the phone and goes nowhere until you share it yourself.
Se hva tegningene våre ble til! 🎨: Look what our drawings turned into! 🎨
Den neste må gjette hva ingenting er …: The next person will have to guess what nothing is …
